profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker SYM, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001837240. Its website describes it as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation for retailers and distributors, covering dense storage, throughput, and supply chain operations. The company says its systems handle goods from as small as 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements.

Symbotic describes itself as the software and key robotic innovator behind each of its solutions, positioning its turnkey approach against integrators it says are limited by their technology partnerships. It states that it is leading the advent of AI software that expands operational possibilities, and that its AI-enhanced software extends visibility beyond the warehouse walls. The company frames its purpose as getting the right goods to people when they need them.

The site's material does not name individual products. The company's litigation record shows 191 cases in Massachusetts.
